summary: The author announces that the lab is open-sourcing Credentio, a new C++ library for C2PA Content Credentials intended to help developers build provenance tools.

practices.reason: A named open-source library for C2PA content credentials could be integrated into a provenance or authenticity pipeline, but the post gives no detail on scope, API surface or adoption requirements.
